guards.name: cpq_package_event_guard
guards.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cpq_package_event_guard BEFORE INSERT ON ppo.cpq_package_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ppo.guard_cpq_package_event()

guards.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER cpq_package_evidence AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON ppo.cpq_packages DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ppo.check_cpq_package_evidence()

guards.name: cpq_package_identity
